title: POP BEAN Wishes Come True: mainland announcement lists CNY 19 single-box launch price
summary: POPMART's verified corporate account announced 泡泡萌粒心愿达成系列公仔 on November 9: mainland online release scheduled for November 12 at 22:00, and stores from November 13 subject to local opening hours. The announcement gives CNY 19 per single blind box and CNY 228 per set, with 12 regular designs and one secret. These are historical announced launch prices, not rechecked current asking prices, completed transactions or proof of present stock. This evidence was added November 15; it is not a new November 15 launch or a catalog-product addition.
